info.title: Agents
info.description: Chat with the agents on this host. The backend keeps the list of chats; the conversation itself lives with the host and reaches the page through the vos/agui host services.

x-app.description: Chat with the agents on this host: they can use your apps, and you see what they do.

methods.name: agents
methods.summary: The agents on this host's roster, to start a chat with.

methods.name: chats
methods.summary: Every chat, most recently used first (at most 200), and the one that was open when the window last closed.

methods.name: startChat
methods.summary: Start a new, empty chat with an agent on the roster, and make it the open one.

errors.message: There is no agent with that id on this host.

methods.name: openChat
methods.summary: Remember which chat is open (null: none), so the window opens on it next time.

errors.message: There is no chat with that id.

methods.name: noteMessage
methods.summary: The person sent a message in a chat: the first one names it, and every one moves it to the top.

errors.message: There is no chat with that id.

Agent.description: An agent on the roster: only what the person needs to pick one.

avatar.description: An icon name, when the agent has one.

Chat.description: One chat as the list shows it. Its conversation is the host's thread `agents:<id>`.

updatedAt.description: When it was last used (ISO 8601, UTC).

open.description: The chat that is open, if it still exists.
